custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the water and the cliff base. AI generators often struggle with realistic water-rock interactions, leading to smearing or unnatural foam patterns. Also, verify that the vegetation on the cliff tops does not blend unnaturally into the rock or sky. Check for any subtle warping in the horizontal stratification lines of the rock face.
image_description: A dramatic coastal landscape featuring steep, dark rock cliffs rising vertically from a turbulent ocean. The cliffs exhibit rugged, weathered textures with visible stratification and erosion patterns. Green vegetation covers the tops of the cliffs and clings to some ledges. A narrow path or road is carved into the side of the left cliff face. In the background, rolling green hills extend towards the horizon under a pale sky.
